capabilities: Add contextual ose_-prefixed classes to the workspace and markdown view container
Expose month, weekday, day, hour, and minute as CSS classes
Convert frontmatter metadata into key-value CSS classes
Sanitize class names by replacing spaces, purging invalid characters, and lowercasing
disambiguation: Does not style anything itself; it only adds class hooks for users and theme-writers to target with their own CSS.
extras: README examples are code blocks shown only as placeholders; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Themes and CSS snippets cannot easily style notes based on the current date/time or the opened file's frontmatter because Obsidian does not expose that context as classes.
summary: Contextual CSS class injector that adds ose-prefixed classes for date, time, and frontmatter values to the workspace and markdown view.
